challenge_focus: Succession challenge on the landing candidate after the held fix batch: the gate now refuses glob metacharacters in partition paths and requires the partition union to equal the reviewed changed set. Attack the fix itself and its interaction with the rest of the gate: can any partition path still make git enumerate something other than the literal path (escaping, unicode, trailing slash, directory-vs-file naming, case folding, symlinked directories, a path that is both a file and a prefix); does scope equality misfire on legitimate manifests (a partition naming a directory that also contains unchanged files, exclusions of added receipts inside a partition, a --paths scope narrower than one partition); and can the succession itself hide an unreviewed byte (the register row and plan edits committed alongside the fix, the npm version pointer bump, the base attestation files).
predecessor_challenge_focuses: Acceptance bypass through the new landing partition manifest path: assume the manifest, the closeout ledgers, and every file under specs/ are caller-controlled. Hunt for any construction that makes review_ledger_binding.py print review_ledger_binding_ok while some byte of the landing candidate (base..HEAD) was never inside a packet an external round froze: exclusion interplay between added receipts and partition paths, fork-point and base handling, a ledger reused across partitions or across candidates, aggregate identity forgery, ordering between the single-ledger path and the manifest path, and any way --print-manifest output differs from what the gate later recomputes. Also probe the failure ordering for a false-negative that refuses a legitimate manifest.
